warm_followup.crash_review_status: Analyzed; exact per-scene evidence in port-errors.json
interpretation: Longji and Bahram each first fault at null address 0x0 on UnityMain during same-package scene switching, then a replacement process hits duplicate NavMeshAgent class registration and SIGTRAP. These differ from the cold allocator signature.

Logs show two Unity initialization threads in the restarted shared package process. Together with static service code constructing separate UnityPlayer instances, this supports a multi-engine lifecycle conflict; it does not prove every later process death has that cause.
Self-directed SIGKILL after lifecycle/timeout events is listed separately from native fatal signals. Other wallpaper packages still running during a capture are excluded from the target scene count.
A warm-window restart count includes the initial process inherited from an earlier scene when its death is present; starts-minus-one would undercount these transitions.
